purpose: Replay and consolidate the surviving finite-k and all-q U1+elliptic-compensator rank theorems on the current tree without choosing M_c, lambda_HL, or UV Wilson coefficients and without claiming production CLASS equivalence.

acceptance.low_k: neutral RTK does not change the leading |k|^4 determinant and filtered matter has an explicit symbolic rank window/root condition
acceptance.all_q: there exists a sufficient flat-FLRW barotropic lambda_HL>1 domain with det B(q)>0 for every q>0
acceptance.near_GR: lambda_HL>1 has a nonempty arbitrarily-near-GR homogeneous normalization interval
acceptance.tensor: the same UV lapse-sign choices do not by themselves obstruct flat TT stability, whose gamma3/gamma5 domain remains separate
acceptance.parameters: no numerical M_c, lambda_HL, beta24, beta8, gamma3 or gamma5 is selected

critical_nonclaims: does not implement the elliptic filtered source in production CLASS
does not prove the all-q sufficient domain for massive-neutrino anisotropic stress or arbitrary nonbarotropic matter
does not certify anisotropic/inhomogeneous backgrounds globally
does not freeze an EFT starting epoch or history-wide M_c lower bound
does not solve C9 radiative naturalness or the local-rest strong-coupling/rank-collapse problem
next_gate_if_pass: freeze the production completion implementation protocol with explicit lambda_HL and a1_eff(a,k), plus a source-history/M_c domain audit before any new likelihood score
